translations.web: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring of Abraham.
translations.bsb: For surely it is not the angels He helps, but the descendants of Abraham.
translations.kjv: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.
translations.asv: For verily not to angels doth he give help, but he giveth help to the seed of Abraham.
